messages.author: 77f0af75bcad6162
messages.subject: Primate census in small areas
parts:
Hi List,



I have some questions about how to design a survey for primates in a small
area. Cocha Cashu Biological Station has a net of trails inside an area of
10 square kilometers. It is very hard to build several long transects, but
it is possible to build a lot of short transects, then, what is more
important: line length or number of transects? If I have to use many short
transects, and I want to calculate the density of primates just in the dry
season of one year. do I have to walk any transect several times or just
once? The "effort" concept is not very clear for me.

Monkeys don't use trails, I think there is no bias generated because the
trail system, or not?



Thanks for your time.

N.
